notes.title: Update v2.0.0
notes.content:
This is our first major update since release!

Welcome to all of the new players who have joined us over the past month as we transitioned away from the old free-to-play model. We are looking forward to providing you with more content to enjoy.

On to the patch notes!

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
[list][*]A new co-op playlist has been added: Chippingrounds
[list][*]Currently this playlist only has one gametype: Survival
[list][*]In this mode, players fight waves of monsters with a shared pool of lives. Defeating all of the waves with at least one player left alive will result in victory. If all players are killed and all lives have been consumed or time runs out before all of the enemy waves are cleared, the match will end in defeat
[/list][/list][*]A new PvP playlist has been added: Big Team (8v8)
[*]Added an announcer that voices many different events in the game such as obtaining medals, announcing gametypes, time left, etc.
[*]Added a 'copy to clipboard' button for social links on the Title screen
[*]Added a red vignette effect when you are below 100% health
[*]There is now a Weekly Challenge to complete each week that will give a large amount of Chips as a reward
[*]New Daily Challenges have been added for the new co-op mode Chippingrounds
[*]A 'continue' button has been added to the end of a match that will place you back in to the match lobby if you desire to play another match
[*]Each server button displayed on Title screen will now show your latency to that server without needing to connect to it first
[*]Added more multi-kill medals:
[list][*]Chiptacular - 6 consecutive kills
[*]Chiptrocity - 7 consecutive kills
[*]Chiptastrophe - 8 consecutive kills
[*]Chipocalypse - 9 consecutive kills
[/list][*]Added more killing spree medals:
[list][*]Chipping Rampage - 20 kills without dying
[*]Chipping Fury - 25 kills without dying
[*]Chipping Storm - 30 kills without dying
[*]Chipping Madness - 35 kills without dying
[/list][*]New Medal: Hero's Duty - Clear a chippinground round as the only player alive with 0 lives left
[*]New Medal: Watch Your Step - Become the last player alive in a chippinground match with 0 lives left
[*]The match time has been added to the match results screen
[*]Some basic localization has been added to important text throughout the game to help those who have trouble understanding english. The following languages are supported:
[list][*]English
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Chinese
[*]Japanese
[/list][*]A new 'sightline' has been added to the Sword and Sniper weapons when charging them that shows you exactly where your weapon will fire
[*]An outline has been added to player characters and pets to make them stand out a bit more
[*]The new outline around players will turn red if that player is not on your team during a match, making your targets easier to distinguish from your own team
[*]The new outline will turn blue for players that are in your group, unless they are on the opposite team in a match
[*]The social lobby has been updated with new buildings that players can enter and explore
[*]Added a Software Cursor toggle in the settings menu (this will make the cursor larger)
[*]Added a subtle particle effect when damaging enemies
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*]All microtransactions have been removed. Any extra Bukkits that players have will be automatically converted to Chips upon login with a message that shows the amount
[list][*]The VIP and FAN packages are being combined in to a VIP DLC Pack that will be available soon
[*]Players that have purchased the old VIP and FAN packages still own them and will have the same benefits of those who purchase the new DLC Pack. No extra purchase necessary
[/list][*]Lowered the default music volume to 40% (previously 80%)
[*]Weapon sprees can now be stacked, removing the need to be killed before you can obtain another one (Sword Spree, Sniper Spree, Sprinkler Party, etc.)
[*]The Catacomb map now has 2D lighting and no longer has a black vignette around the camera screen
[*]The Paintbow weapon will now fire shots at max range 100% of the time instead of ending at your mouse cursor
[*]Slightly increased the max range of the Paintbow weapon
[*]Updated artwork and colors across the entire game
[*]Some item requirements and Item prices have been adjusted
[*]Some in-game tips have been updated and new ones have been added
[*]Some Daily Challenges have been modified
[*]The Sprinkler and Paintbow weapons have been added to the Twin Isles map
[*]The Sword weapon now has a short cooldown if it is used before fully charging it
[*]The Sniper weapon now has a short cooldown if it is used before fully charging it
[*]The camera zoom feature on all maps has been disabled and replaced with an option to follow your mouse cursor
[*]Non-VIP players can now stack Chip Boosts up to 3 max

[*]Consecutive daily login rewards have been updated:
[list][*]Day 1: 700 chips
[*]Day 2: 1,000 chips
[*]Day 3: 1 chip boost
[*]Day 4: 1,300 chips
[*]Day 5: 1,600 chips
[*]Day 6: 1 chip boost
[*]Day 7: 5,000 chips and 1 chip boost

notes.title: Transitioning from Free to Paid
notes.content:
Greetings Chipsters!

We have some important news to share regarding Paint Chips. We've taken quite a long hiatus on this project and have recently returned to continue development. With a lot of internal discussion [b]we've decided to transition to a paid model starting [u]October 1st, 2023[/u].[/b] The game will cost [b]$14.99[/b].

[h2]Why the change?[/h2]
The biggest problem with our game is the lack of players online. The original idea of releasing the game for free was to allow anyone to download and try it out. Being a game you don't have to pay for also seems to include it being a game you don't have to care about.

According to our data from release up to the date of this post, only about [b]10% of players continued playing past their third match[/b] (roughly 10 minutes of playtime), and only about [b]5% continued past their tenth match[/b] (~30 minutes). That means [b]90% of players who tried the game have played it for less than 10 minutes[/b].

With such a small community, the free version is not holding up as well as we would like. We feel that if players purchase the game, maybe they'll invest a little more time in to it before deciding to put it away or get a refund. Of course we could be wrong, but we're going to give the paid version a chance.

[b]We want to continue adding new features, improve gameplay and make the game into something we're proud of. We love this game and want everyone who plays it to enjoy their time with it.[/b]

[h2]What does this mean for you?[/h2]
[b]Current Owners:[/b] If you already own Paint Chips, congratulations! You're all set and can continue enjoying the game without any additional cost.

[b]Future Access:[/b] For those who haven't yet downloaded the game, starting on [b]October 1st[/b], a one-time purchase will be required for new players. [b]If you add the game to your Steam library before the transition date, you will own the game for free![/b]

[h2]What happens to the in-game microtransactions?[/h2]
They're gone!

Bukkits will no longer be available for purchase. [b]We're planning to convert the VIP and FAN packages to paid DLC.[/b] If you've [b]already purchased[/b] one or both of these, [b]you will still own them in-game[/b].

[b]Any Bukkits in your possession will be automatically converted to Chips for you.[/b] There's no need to worry about purchasing any items using your remaining Bukkits as they will be converted to the appropriate Chip value for the items in the shop.

[h2]After the transition:[/h2]
We have a large update planned to be released very soon after the change from free to paid. We expect to be ready to release it on the same day. It will include new medals, a new co-op gametype and some new features. It will also include many improvements to existing systems. We also plan on opening the EU server once again!

If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/8DcVh55WqW]reach out to us on Discord[/url].

We want to express our sincere thanks for your ongoing support. Your passion drives us to create an even better experience. Thank you for being a part of Paint Chips. Together, we'll continue to make this game amazing!

<3
The PhatRobit Team

notes.title: Minor Patch - Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
I've been putting off controller support for some time, so have decided to release what I have to help out players that like to play on Steam Deck. This update adds a little bit of controller support, so players on Steam Deck or a gamepad should have a slightly more enjoyable experience. Also for Steam Deck / Linux users, I've fixed the 'Quit' buttons so it actually closes the game now instead of freezing up. For whatever reason, Unity doesn't like to close on Linux machines using the regular method of quitting the application, so I had to add a workaround.

There are also a few small additions, such as a small effect on your feet if you're currently standing in friendly paint. There may be some other small things I'm forgetting, but that's all for now!

Thanks for playing our game, have fun!

notes.title: v1.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Europe Server Shut Down[/h1]
The Europe server has been shut down until further notice. This decision was made mainly due to the low popularity of the game at this time. Once the community grows, we will add more servers as needed. Until then, we will just have the North America and Asia servers running.

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
There is now a dedicated Tutorial mode for new players (or old players who forgot how to play?). It's still a new thing, so it will be improved over time. For now it's fairly basic and has you complete certain tasks to try and help new players learn the general idea of the game mechanics.

[h1]Playlists[/h1]
We've now added playlists to Quick Play! A playlist is a way for us to set up more specific rules for how you want to play. The main change is that Gametypes will no longer determine the team sizes, and instead the Playlists will be in control of that. There are currently three playlists you can choose from at this time:
[list]
[*]FFA - No Teams!
[*]Team - 4 vs 4 battles
[*]Doubles - 2 vs 2 vs 2 vs 2 battles (was previously Team Doubles)
[/list]
We have also converted the Double XP Weekend bonus to be applied to a random Playlist instead of a random Gametype, so now you can farm those chips as much as you desire each weekend!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]New Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*]Playlists have been added to Quick Play
[*]A new Tutorial has been added to help new players learn the basic idea of the game
[*]A new Help button has been added to the escape menu in the Social lobby, which includes the following:
[list]
[*]"I'm Stuck" button - Same function as before (returns you to the spawn point in the Social area), but now located in the help menu instead
[*]Tutorial button - Puts you in a tutorial match that helps you understand the basic gameplay mechanics and goals
[*]Medal Index button - Displays a list of every medal in the game along with how to earn each one
[/list][*]Added Achievement for September item collection
[*]Added clothing items for September
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Due to Playlists now being a thing, the FFA and Team variants of each gametype have been smushed into generic versions of themselves (Team Paintmatch is now just Paintmatch, etc.)
[*]The Double XP Weekend event is now set to a Playlist instead of a Gametype
[*]The 'Practice Match' option for new players has been removed, replaced by the 'Tutorial' option
[*]Increased the Rocket Launcher's paint points per shot
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Viewing someone's stats will no longer display chip count or item information (it wasn't working anyway)

notes.title: Update v1.7.0
notes.content:
Hello there!

In this update, we have a few quality of life improvements as well as some changes to gametypes. We've brought back Swipers and combined a few other gametypes into each other, reducing the total number of gametypes while retaining similar gameplay for them.

[h2]Friends List / Social Updates[/h2]
There's now an in-game friends list (separate from your Steam friends) and a few new social options for other players around you, such as being able to ignore or report them. You can now also view the stats for other players.

To add a friend, you can send a request to them either by clicking on their character and selecting the 'Friend' button, or by clicking on their name in the new Social list and selecting that same 'Friend' button. This will send a friend request to them and you will become friends if they accept! If you already have a friend request from the player you send your own request to, you will automatically become friends.

Unfriending someone is a similar process, minus the request part. Just click on a user that's your friend or from your friend list, and click 'Unfriend'. This will remove them as your friend and will also remove you from their friend list.

Ignoring someone can be useful if you don't want to see any chat messages from them or emotes. To ignore someone, simply click on their character or button in the social list and select 'Ignore'. If for whatever reason you want to hear what they have to say again, you can 'Unignore' them the same way.

Reporting players is fairly simple as well. Just select 'Report' from the player menu and choose whichever reason(s) you are reporting them for. Hit the 'Submit' button and a report will be sent over to use for review. Please note that we will review each reported player manually and no action will be taken unless we deem it necessary, This may become automated at some point later, but for now to reduce the number of false positives, it will be done directly by us.

[h2]FAN Package[/h2]
We've also added another paid package we're calling the FAN package. This is pretty similar to the VIP package, but a little bit cheaper. It gives you access to more items and an additional Chip discount in the item shop! It's a one time purchase of $8.

[h3]More Stuff[/h3]
We added a couple of new weapons and we're curious to see what you all think of them. They're now available in every map. Give them a try and let us know how you like (or don't like) them [url=https://discord.gg/vWVmaFga7p]in our Discord server[/url]!

Hello everyone!

Apologies for the delay on this update, but it's here now! We're happy to bring you a new limited-time map for the Autumn season, Fall Manor! We've also added some new items, some themed for 'Back to School', but have not quite finished everything yet. Please be patient as we work to add the rest of the planned items for this season!

The most notable thing in this update is probably the new Bug Report feature! You can now send in bug reports directly from the game. This will make it easier on you and on us when coming across any issues. All you need to do is click on the red Bug Report button in the Social Lobby area, located at the top right corner of the screen (next to the VIP button). It will open a panel where you can type in a description of the issue you are facing and submit it to us for review.

We would like to let you know that this new form is only for bugs and not for reporting players. If you try to report a player using the Bug Report form, it will more than likely just be ignored. We will have a proper Player Report option in the future!

One last thing - We're opening two more servers! There will now be a server running in Asia and one in Europe along with the North America server. These new servers are temporary for the moment, but will hopefully become permanent. They will remain online for at least one or two months.

When playing on a different server, all of your progress (except Leaderboard status) will carry over with you on whichever server you select, so you don't need to worry about starting over. Your Leaderboard rank will not carry over between servers however, so you will have a different Leaderboard rank depending on which server you're playing on. The Daily Challenges will now be synced across servers as well. notes.title: Public Beta 3 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Chipsters!

We don't have as many changes due to it only being a week since the previous test, but we did get some things done.

The largest change is to how player data is saved. Previously, player save data was saved to the server. It worked fine, but the issue is that players would not be able to carry over their save data if they wanted to switch servers. We made changes so that player data is now saved to a database which can be accessed by any server, thus allowing players to hop between servers while retaining their progress. This change has reset everyone's progress in the beta, but all progress will be reset again on May 4th once the game is fully released, so it isn't anything to worry about.

Here's a list of what's changed over the past week:

[list]
[*]New Stuff
[list]
[*]Player save data is now stored in a database instead of the server
[*]Team colors can now be selected by the host in custom games
[*]Explosions (bombs / rockets) now check line of sight on impact, so you can avoid damage by hiding behind things
[*]Added some new daily challenges for specific weapon kills (blaster, sniper, rockets, bombs)
[*]A short description has been added to the beginning of the match describing the main goal of the game type
[/list]
[*]Changes
[list]
[*]Collision has been added to the Sniper weapon, so it can no longer shoot through obstacles
[*]Rockets are now synced over the network better
[*]Objects and effects have been added to the Wonderland map
[*]Crosshairs have been updated with a dark outline to make it easier to keep track of in bright areas of the screen
[/list]
[*]Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug causing you to join multiple matches at the same time (thanks mystrert!)
[/list]
[/list]

If you run in to any issues, please let us know on our Discord server. This test will run until Monday, April 19th at 12AM PST.

Have fun!
